name: AntivaryOn
sum_comp_perm_smul_eq_sum_smul_iff
result.signature:
(hfg : AntivaryOn f g s) (hσ : {x | σ x ≠ x} ⊆ s) :
  ∑ i ∈ s, f (σ i) • g i = ∑ i ∈ s, f i • g i ↔ AntivaryOn (f ∘ σ) g s
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α]
  [ExistsAddOfLE α] [inst_4 : AddCommMonoid β] [inst_5 : LinearOrder β] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid β]
  [inst_7 : Module α β] [PosSMulStrictMono α β] {s : Finset ι} {σ : Equiv.Perm ι} {f : ι → α} {g : ι → β},
  AntivaryOn f g ↑s → {x | σ x ≠ x} ⊆ ↑s → (∑ i ∈ s, f (σ i) • g i = ∑ i ∈ s, f i • g i ↔ AntivaryOn (f ∘ ⇑σ) g ↑s)
result.informal_name: Sum Equality under Permutation and Antivarying Condition
result.informal_description: Let $ s $ be a finite set, $ \sigma $ a permutation with support contained in $ s $, and $ f, g $ functions satisfying the antivarying condition on $ s $. Then the equality $ \sum_{i \in s} f(\sigma(i)) \cdot g(i) = \sum_{i \in s} f(i) \cdot g(i) $ holds if and only if the composed function $ f \circ \sigma $ and $ g $ also satisfy the antivarying condition on $ s $.

    obtain ⟨_, r...
result.informal_name: Sum Equality Under Permutation Implies Monovary Condition
result.informal_description: Let $ s $ be a finite set, $ f $ and $ g $ be functions defined on $ s $, and $ \sigma $ a permutation of $ s $ such that $ \sigma(x) \neq x $ only for $ x \in s $. Then the equality $ \sum_{i \in s} f(i) \cdot g(\sigma(i)) = \sum_{i \in s} f(i) \cdot g(i) $ holds if and only if the pair $ (f, g \circ \sigma) $ satisfies the `MonovaryOn` condition on $ s $.

result.informal_name: Sum Equality under Permutation and Antivarying Condition
result.informal_description: Let $ f $ and $ g $ be functions antivarying on a finite set $ s $, and let $ \sigma $ be a permutation such that $ \{x \mid \sigma x \ne x\} \subseteq s $. Then the equality $ \sum_{i \in s} f(i) \cdot g(\sigma(i)) = \sum_{i \in s} f(i) \cdot g(i) $ holds if and only if $ f $ and $ g \circ \sigma $ also antivary on $ s $.

result.informal_name: Equality of Permuted Sums Characterizes MonovaryOn Condition
result.informal_description: Given a finite set $s$ and a permutation $\sigma$ whose non-fixed points are contained in $s$, the equality $\sum_{i \in s} f(\sigma i) \cdot g(i) = \sum_{i \in s} f(i) \cdot g(i)$ holds if and only if the permuted function $f \circ \sigma$ and $g$ satisfy the MonovaryOn condition over $s$.

name: MvPolynomial
psum_isSymmetric
result.type:
∀ (σ : Type u_5) (R : Type u_6) [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (n : ℕ),
  (MvPolynomial.psum σ R n).IsSymmetric
result.informal_description: For each natural number $ n $, the power sum polynomial $ \sum_{i \in \sigma} X_i^n $ in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $ is symmetric, where $ \sigma $ is a finite type.
